title: 40 Seconds To Midnight - 2400 unit battle (Stresstest) Basic Animations
author: TheRook21
selftext:
So I've been working on my RTS game engine capabilities - looking at 16 players with at the moment 150 unit - so wanted to do a stress test by having 16 AI players spawn in a large number of units and keep respawning them to look for performance issues etc.

It's a long way from a finished product but I'm heavily inspired by my years of playing RTS games from Command and Conquer series, Starcraft Series, Warcraft Series Total Annihilation.

I am aiming for the ability for 16 players to fight against each other, build up an engine that can cope with it all including additional spectators, and build an editor as capable as the SC2 editor so people can keep building the types of maps they want to enjoy - I know I enjoyed custom maps!

Have a little look, I have been using AI to move me away from Unity and into Stride and it has helped me advanced my engines capabilities and my games capabilities as I kept getting stuck or not progressing with Unity so I went on a big Hiatus last year and came back hard from the summer.
